BiblicalUsage: Naarai is one of David's mighty men, named once in the list of the warriors. In 1 Chronicles 11:37 he stands as Naarai the son of Ezbai, counted among the men who stood with David.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the mighty men are remembered by name because loyalty is worth naming. Naarai has one verse, and that verse puts him beside the king.
